frequency_question: What proportion of major announced commercial vehicle green transition subsidy schemes are formally notified and operationalized within 3 years of initial policy drafting?
membership_rule: Includes central government schemes explicitly targeting heavy commercial electric vehicles (buses and trucks) with dedicated financial outlays, interest subsidies, or credit guarantees. Excludes general passenger vehicle subsidies (like FAME-style passenger car incentives) and state-level provincial policies.

cases.name: India FAME-II Scheme Extension and Commercial Vehicle Focus
India PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components
National Electric Mobility Mission Plan Phase II Direct Commercial Fleet Outlays

coverage_note: 3 named; believed roughly 4 to 5 total comparable major federal commercial vehicle industrial policy rollouts in this jurisdiction class.
known_gaps: Excludes provincial/state-level electric bus aggregation schemes (like CESL deployments) which operate under different administrative pathways.
skeleton: Three major policy initiatives examined. This case differs by having stronger institutional pressure from prior framework iterations (FAME I and II learnings) but faces tighter fiscal deficit constraints and more complex banking sector coordination for credit guarantees.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 3 named comparable heavy vehicle / major automotive capital incentive policies successfully finalized and notified on schedule.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic momentum and ministry procedural templates remain stable across this electoral term.
